title: Container Bookings: no-show closure and the no-show fee
content:
## Policy clause
When the allocated sailing departs while a Container Bookings booking is still confirmed or equipment released, meaning no laden container was gated in before the cargo cut-off, the system closes the booking as a no-show and moves it to cancelled, with the departure date as its cancellation date. A no-show fee of the tier's per-container no-show fee multiplied by the booked containers is then charged, carrying the sailing that was missed.

The no-show is judged against the sailing on the booking at departure time: a booking rolled off a sailing before it departed did not miss it. A booking the customer cancelled before departure is never a no-show; it bears the cancellation fee instead. A no-show fee may be booked only on a booking whose status is cancelled. A booking carries at most one no-show fee and never both a no-show fee and a cancellation fee. No-show fees count toward the customer's no-show record, and they may be waived only as goodwill.

## Input, judgement, output
| Input at the sailing's departure | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Booking confirmed or equipment released on that sailing | no-show | booking cancelled with the departure date; no-show fee charged with the missed sailing |
| Booking rolled off that sailing before it departed | not a no-show for that sailing | no fee for that sailing |
| Booking cancelled by the customer before departure | never a no-show | cancellation fee rules apply instead |
| Booking already carries a cancellation fee or a no-show fee | second terminal fee barred | no no-show fee is added |

## Worked example (hypothetical rate)
*Hypothetical per-container no-show fee of 200.00, for illustration only:* a booking of 4 containers, still equipment released when its sailing departs, is closed as a no-show and charged 200.00 multiplied by 4, that is 800.00, carrying the missed sailing.

## Points of judgement
**Who closes the booking as a no-show?** The system, on departure of the allocated sailing; the desk does not.

**Can a no-show fee be waived on any basis other than goodwill?** No. It may be waived only as goodwill.
